validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE + SPEC: confirmed. The Egyptian Cabinet press office's 'Harvest of 2023' annual roundup for the Ministry of Petroleum (https://www.cabinet.gov.eg/News/Details/74700, dated 28 Dec 2023) contains a specific, detailed paragraph on this exact project: 'المرحلة الأولى من تنمية حقول شمال جيسوم الشمالى GNN ينتج المشروع 12 ألف برميل زيت خام يومياً من خلال حفر 3 آبار وانشاء خط بقطر 10 بوصة وطول 5.3 كم وذلك بتكلفة استثمارية حوالي 23 مليون دولار...وتم بدء الإنتاج في مارس 2023' -- translation: 'Phase 1 of developing the North Geisum GNN fields: the project produces 12 thousand barrels of crude oil per day by drilling 3 wells and constructing a 10-inch-diameter, 5.3 km pipeline, at an investment cost of about $23 million...production began in March 2023.' This independently matches, at the exact value, FOUR separate GEM fields simultaneously: LengthKnown=5.30 km, Diameter=10 in, Capacity=12,000 bpd, Cost=23,000,000 USD -- plus Status=operating and StartYear1=2023 (with month = March). Fuel=Oil is consistent ('زيت خام' = crude oil). FuelSource='Northern Geisum Oil Fields' matches 'حقول شمال جيسوم الشمالى GNN'. StartState/Province and EndState/Province = 'Suez Gulf' matches the field's location in the Gulf of Suez ('بخليج السويس', stated elsewhere on the same page re: this same field). This is NOT a GEM-only/hallucinated entity -- it is a real, specific, government-documented small field flowline. url_verifier's automated FAIL on the Capacity/Cost cells ('12,000.00' / '23000000' not found as literal substrings) is a false negative: the source states these in Arabic prose ('12 ألف برميل' = 12 thousand barrels; '23 مليون دولار' = 23 million dollars) -- confirmed identical in value by manual read, per the project's standing prose/unit-equivalence rule. CLASSIFICATION caveat (not escalated to a concern): PipelineType='transmission' is applied uniformly across this whole 2026 batch of short Egyptian field-connector oil lines regardless of length (checked against sibling rows P7339 Abu Rudis-Wadi Feran LPG, 13 km, and P7338 Dekhela-Wadi Al Qamar LPG, 7 km -- both also 'transmission'), so this is a consistent researcher convention across the cohort, not a P7329-specific defect; a case could be made this is really a field gathering flowline (3 new wellheads -> facilities) rather than 'transmission' in the strict long-haul sense, but since the convention is applied uniformly it is a batch-level question, not an isolated error, so not flagged as a standalone concern here. validity.researcher_notes: The current Owner [ref] (http://www.egpc.com.eg/About_EGPC.aspx) is a generic 'About EGPC' corporate page -- it is live (200) but says nothing about this specific pipeline or field, so it does not actually corroborate '100% EGPC' ownership of this asset; per the standing rule, a generic/aggregate citation that doesn't name the specific asset is a genuine attribution gap, not a verified fact. This matters here because the wider Geisum field cluster in the Gulf of Suez is NOT uniformly EGPC-operated: English Wikipedia's Lukoil article (checked via API, live) lists 'West Geisum' and 'Northeast Geisum' as active Lukoil-Egypt portfolio fields (concessions typically structured as EGPC/EGAS + a private JV partner, with EGPC often retaining nominal/government ownership while a JV operates). 'North Geisum'/'GNN' is a distinct block from West/NE Geisum, and I could not confirm its operator independently (no dedicated source found; WebSearch budget was exhausted and Bing/DuckDuckGo scraping was blocked -- see main validity note). The cabinet.gov.eg press release itself is a Ministry-of-Petroleum-wide annual roundup and does not name a specific operator/JV for this line item either -- it only frames it under the national petroleum sector's overall 2023 achievements. This is plausibly correct as GEM's standard convention (EGPC nominally owns Egyptian petroleum infrastructure under the concession-law structure even where a JV partner operates day-to-day), so I am not recommending a value change, but it is unverified against the current ref and should be checked before being treated as confirmed.
